_comment: Single source of truth for the models people can use. Edit, then `terraform apply`: the gateway policy, the model aliases pinned for every engineer, and the admin app all follow. Set price fields (USD per million tokens, from your Vertex price list) to show cost hints; null hides them. Every enabled entry is allowed (availableModels); the "default" entry is listed first AND set as the policy's starting `model`, because Anthropic documents that availableModels alone does not change a gateway session's default. The default model must be enabled in Vertex Model Garden for your project, or every session fails. Optional "family" (sonnet|opus|haiku; defaults to the alias when it is one of those) and "pin" (default true only when alias == family): only a pinned entry sets ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<FAMILY>_MODEL, at most one per family; a family with entries but no pin is flagged. As shipped: Haiku 5.5 is the default (tier "default"), Sonnet 4.6 is the Sonnet pin, Opus 5.5 the Opus pin; Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 4.6 are allowed by name. To start everyone on Sonnet 4.6 instead: set "default" to "sonnet-4-6", give sonnet-4-6 the tier "default" and haiku the tier "fast", reword the descriptions. To pin Opus 4.6 as the Opus alias: set "pin": true on opus-4-6 and "pin": false on opus (swap their tiers too). After either: copy this file to client/models.json, terraform apply, rebuild the installer with scripts/package-client.sh and have people run `update`. Claude 4.6 on Vertex is served from global, us-east5, europe-west1 and asia-southeast1 (not europe-west2); check Model Garden for the other models in your region.

models.label: Sonnet 5.5
models.description: The newer Sonnet generation, available by name when you want to try it.

models.label: Opus 5.5
models.description: Hardest problems. Costs more and uses budget faster, so it is an explicit step up.

models.label: Haiku 5.5
models.description: Fast and cheap. The baseline everyone starts on; step up to Sonnet or Opus when a task needs it.

models.label: Sonnet 4.6
models.description: Everyday coding, a step up from Haiku. Available by name; it is the Sonnet the sonnet alias resolves to.

models.label: Opus 4.6
models.description: The previous Opus generation, available by name. Costs more and uses budget faster.
